Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1423
Claimant:
Kelly Romero
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
9-22-24
Claim opened after the insured reported a collision at an intersection while turning left, with the claimant's vehicle
struck on the driver side. The claimant reports a knee injury and has no legal representation at this stage.
11-13-24
Photos from the scene confirm the damage pattern and show the vehicle's front end and side panels consistent with
the reported impact. No independent witnesses have come forward, so the photos are the main visual record at this
point.
11-30-24
Police report lsits the claimant as an occupant of the vehicle, and the statements of the other parties agree on that
point. The driver is named on the policy, and nothing so far suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
1-25-25
Claimant gave the same account of the collision in each contact so far, describing the left turn and the moment of
impact in matching detail. Vehicle inspection found no earlier damage on record, and the repair estimate lines up with
the impact described.
2-3-25
Medical records show a knee injury that fits the kind and force of the crash. No prior injury to the same body area is
on file. Treatment followed a typical course and tapered off as the claimant improved.
3-15-25
Based on the photos, police report, medical records, and consistent statements, the claim appears to be supported
by the available evidence. File remains open for final review of the treatment billing and the repair invoice.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
